decisions.reason: The modular waste processing concept extends the firm's core systems business and already has strong quantified customer value, so a withdrawal in the next year is unlikely.
This mobile slow-speed shredder fits closely with the established recycling portfolio and a growing machinery maker would usually keep developing such a core-adjacent product rather than remove it.
As a flagship multi-model line that matches the firm's stated direction toward modular environmental technology, it is very unlikely to be taken off the market soon.
The mobile trommel screen complements the firm's processing equipment range, though with less visible evidence of standout traction than the flagship modular concepts.
The 2024 slow-speed shredder line is close to the firm's core offer and its multi-model rollout suggests commitment to building out this segment rather than exiting it quickly.

The mobile spiral shaft screens support the firm's modular and application-specific positioning, but as a newer line building on rather than sitting at the very center of the portfolio they carry slightly more risk than the flagship products.
